snippet.title: ONETALE MOD RELEASE! Niko from Oneshot in Undertale!
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: https://gamejolt.com/games/Onetale/726821

an undertale mod by theshiberealm

[The messiah has come home.]

[Another adventure awaits them, however.]

[They have heard stories of the mountain near their village.]

[Stories of people who never came back down.]

[Curious, they decide to venture upwards to see the validity of these rumors.]

[...]

[They were true.]

CREDITS:

(Twitter handles are the ones with the @'s)

@TheShibeRealm - Coding, Sprite editing, basically all the dumb stuff lmao
SamiTheAnxiousBean on Reddit and Discord - Additional Sprite Work
The Entire Thunderdome Discord server, without them this mod wouldn't have been possible!
@Cinderclasm aka cinder: Ideas, advice, also helped keep the mod going
@nikonotcat1 aka labyoki: Created the intro cutscene sprites, which look magnificent 
@fruttymoment aka frutty: Ideas, advice, helped with name screen ideas
@chazzerbox__ aka chaz: The creator of Misfire, Ideas, advice (really cool guy check him out)
also all the people in the name easter egg screen (what? you didn't think there would be
new name easter eggs?)
@Lutheeerrrr aka luther: existing :)
The Oneshot Aftermath team: Original artists of shadow niko sprites. Please support the devs. They are doing gods work.
The Oneshot Fading Memory Team: some sprites come from this game. please support these devs as well. Both fan projects deserve support!
Manfish64 and lunchlessbaghead on youtube: creators of Asriel Hug sprites.
thank you for allowing me to use them!
r/underminers and r/undermodders: helping me figure out how undertalemodtool works
(seriously these guys helped me figure out so much)
@Celery_Soda aka sodder: Creator of the legendary thunderdome music track. its hidden somewhere in the game. Try to find it!
Undertale Bits and Pieces: for just existing. Taught me how a lot of
code works. (i WILL figure out how to put the oneshot border in one
day. one. day.)

The original Oneshot dev team, Future Cat 
Nightmargin
Eliza Velasquez
Michael Shirt
Degica
Mark Conforti

Toby Fox: The creation of Undertale, pretty cool guy i think

and YOU

YEAH THATS RIGHT THE PERSON READING THIS RIGHT NOW
YOU DIDN'T THINK I WAS GONNA LEAVE YOU OUT DID YOU???????????

NOW YOU MAYBE WONDERING WHAT THIS MOD IS ABOUT
what is this mod about
BASICALLY
--niko oneshot is now in the game hehe

--all sprites that even MENTION frisk have been replaced with niko

--new name easter eggs have been added, try some oneshot characters! (and maybe, some of
the people in the credits hehehehe)
--also due to the new easter eggs you can now have 10 characters for your name instead
of 6 (warning, using all 10 characters WILL break some things, nothing will crash though
basically just text wrapping and some parts of the hud overlapping)
SOME new text, not much though
--basically if you want niko oneshot in your undertale game, this is the mod to have :)
why dont you open the game in undertalemodtool? there may be some funny secrets there hehe
(also dont spoil the name easter eggs, though if enough people figure it out ill release them

ALSO REPORT BUGS TO ME CAUSE I HAVE NO IDEA IF I BROKE ANYTHING LOL

REPORT THEM HERE @TheShibeRealm (yes my twitter i will probably reply within 1 second)

also there may be a version 2 if i can find a way to add the new things i want
